description: This file defines a class 'Ssr' that extends the Opencart system Controller, responsible for generating static HTML pages (caching) from dynamic responses based on specific route triggers within an OpenCart e-commerce project.

classes.name: Ssr
classes.description: Handles server-side rendering cache creation for specific page routes within the OpenCart catalog, by saving the current page output as a static HTML file.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method triggered after specific route actions to generate and save static HTML pages based on the dynamic output.
